_doc: Pronunciation fixes, applied to the spoken text only (subtitles keep the original). A [[…]] value is raw IPA for Kokoro. Checked with the narration-lexicon skill (Whisper). Remaining Whisper diffs left on purpose: French 'pull' (always heard as pôle/pool whatever the spelling), French homophones (suis/suit, la/l'a, numérotées), Italian 'Claude' and 'story' (Whisper's Italian prior).
